steps.label: Train, then evaluate

steps.label: Deploy, then monitor
steps.sub: roll out behind a serving endpoint; watch live accuracy and input drift

code:
def ml_pipeline(raw_data):
    train_df, val_df, test_df = prepare_data(raw_data)
    model = train(train_df, hyperparams)
    metrics = evaluate(model, test_df)

    if metrics["f1"] < production_model.metrics["f1"]:
        return "blocked: did not clear the evaluation gate"

    deploy(model)          # canary or blue/green rollout
    return "promoted to production"
caption: Every stage is a function call — repeatable, versioned, and re-runnable on fresh data.

code:
# A drift alert doesn't end the pipeline — it restarts it:

while True:
    alert = monitor_production(deployed_model)
    if alert.drift_detected:
        fresh_data = pull_latest_data()
        ml_pipeline(fresh_data)   # back to stage 1
    sleep(check_interval)
caption: Monitoring feeds back into data preparation — that feedback loop is the whole point.
